It's the same trade-off from Module Zero, and it's worth repeating here because this whole module is built around it.

beats.vo: Property two: composability. DeFi protocols plug into each other, like building blocks. A stablecoin can be deposited into a lending market. The interest-bearing receipt from that lending market can be deposited into a yield vault. That vault's shares can be used as collateral somewhere else. Composability is what makes DeFi powerful, letting small pieces combine into complex products.
